test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 16 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Sheetal incurred 28% loss by selling an item for Rs. 207. What was the cost price of the item?
solution:
**GIVEN:**

loss incurred by sheetal = 28% 

selling price of an item = Rs.207 

**FORMULA USED :**

Loss = (C.P. - S.P. ) where, C.P. and S.P. are Cost Price and Selling Price respectively.

Loss % = (Loss/C.P. ) × 100 

**CALCULATION:**

28 = [(C.P. - 207)/C.P.] × 100

⇒ 28/100 = (C.P. -207)/C.P. 

⇒ 28 C.P. =( 100 C.P. -20700 )

⇒ 72 C.P. = 20700 

⇒ C.P. = Rs.287.50 

**∴ The value of C.P. is Rs.287.50.**
